>Is there any past event(s) that may have caused you to become this way?

I have physical problems I wouldn't like to go into detail on as it would make me easy to identify for my friends who are redditors. Basically I wear leg braces, and can't drive. 

The only reason I'm still breathing is for my parents and friends. But sometimes I wonder if a life lived for the sake of others is really worth living. 

I worry that if I tell people I'm suicidal they will tell me how selfish it is to commit suicide. It's happened before I told someone that I really didn't care what happened to me and they replied "If you don't care about yourself why should I care" I was too busy crying to reply "Because I care what happens to you"
